# volcano_project_health (Data Source)

A project's current health status, derived from automated lifecycle/storage checks across its resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_project_health" "example" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `checks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks))
- `data_status` (String) complete, partial, no_data, or stale.
- `findings` (Attributes List) Top findings ordered by severity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--findings))
- `fresh_through` (String)
- `observed_at` (String)
- `status` (String) healthy, degraded, critical, or unknown.
